# Project Rules

Read every rule file on a matching line before doing that kind of work. Rules override your defaults.

## Read when

- Writing or refactoring any code - [common/coding-style.md](.agents/rules/common/coding-style.md), [common/patterns.md](.agents/rules/common/patterns.md)
- Writing shell commands or referencing file paths - [common/path-conventions.md](.agents/rules/common/path-conventions.md)
- Starting a multi-step feature - [common/development-workflow.md](.agents/rules/common/development-workflow.md)
- Writing or changing tests - [common/testing.md](.agents/rules/common/testing.md)
- Committing, branching, or opening PRs - [common/git-workflow.md](.agents/rules/common/git-workflow.md)
- Touching auth, secrets, user data, or payments - [common/security.md](.agents/rules/common/security.md)
- Optimizing slow code or builds - [common/performance.md](.agents/rules/common/performance.md)
- Reviewing a diff or finalizing before merge - [common/code-review.md](.agents/rules/common/code-review.md)
- Writing or editing documentation (README, guides, changelogs) - [common/documentation.md](.agents/rules/common/documentation.md)
- Configuring or editing agent hooks - [common/hooks.md](.agents/rules/common/hooks.md)
- Editing Typescript files - also read: [typescript/coding-style.md](.agents/rules/typescript/coding-style.md), [typescript/hooks.md](.agents/rules/typescript/hooks.md), [typescript/patterns.md](.agents/rules/typescript/patterns.md), [typescript/security.md](.agents/rules/typescript/security.md), [typescript/testing.md](.agents/rules/typescript/testing.md)
